WATER_REACTIVE.title: Water-Reactive & Pyrophoric
WATER_REACTIVE.cabinet: Cabinet A: Dry / Inert Box (No Water Sprinklers)
WATER_REACTIVE.description: Substances that react violently or emit flammable gases upon contact with water or air.

OXIDIZER.title: Oxidizing Agents
OXIDIZER.cabinet: Cabinet B: Oxidizers Cabinet (Keep Away from Organics)
OXIDIZER.description: Chemicals that may cause or intensify fire; store strictly away from flammables and reducing agents.

FLAMMABLE.title: Flammable Liquids & Solids
FLAMMABLE.cabinet: Cabinet C: Ventilated Flammable Safety Cabinet
FLAMMABLE.description: Volatile solvents and ignitable solids requiring fire-rated containment.

ACUTE_TOXIC.title: Acutely Toxic & Poisons
ACUTE_TOXIC.cabinet: Cabinet D: Locked Poison / Toxic Cabinet
ACUTE_TOXIC.description: Chemicals with fatal or toxic acute inhalation, dermal, or oral hazard (GHS Cat. 1-3).

CORROSIVE_ACID.title: Corrosive Acids
CORROSIVE_ACID.description: Inorganic and organic acids; keep strictly separated from bases and cyanides/sulfides.

CORROSIVE_BASE.title: Corrosive Bases (Alkalies)
CORROSIVE_BASE.cabinet: Cabinet E2: Base / Alkali Corrosion-Resistant Cabinet
CORROSIVE_BASE.description: Hydroxides, amines, and alkaline solutions; store in secondary polyethylene trays away from acids.

HEALTH_HAZARD.title: Chronic Health Hazards (CMR / Sensitizers)
HEALTH_HAZARD.cabinet: Cabinet F: Designated Hazardous / Well-Ventilated Shelf
HEALTH_HAZARD.description: Carcinogens, mutagens, reproductive toxins, or target organ toxicants.

GENERAL_STORAGE.title: General Laboratory Chemicals
GENERAL_STORAGE.cabinet: Cabinet G: Standard General Chemical Shelving
GENERAL_STORAGE.description: Low-hazard salts, buffers, and mild irritants compatible with standard shelving.

WATER_REACTIVE.reason: Store together only in dry secondary containment; check individual reactivity.

OXIDIZER.reason: Extreme fire and explosion hazard upon contact.

FLAMMABLE.reason: High fire risk; water-reactives can ignite volatile vapors.

ACUTE_TOXIC.reason: Isolate water-reactives from toxic inventory to prevent toxic plume release.

CORROSIVE_ACID.reason: Violent exothermic reaction with aqueous acids and evolution of flammable/toxic gas.

HEALTH_HAZARD.reason: Strict isolation required for water-reactive compounds.

GENERAL_STORAGE.reason: Keep away from hydrated salts and aqueous buffers.

OXIDIZER.reason: Compatible oxidizers (separate strong peroxides from inorganic nitrates).

FLAMMABLE.reason: Severe fire/explosion hazard: oxidizers fuel rapid combustion of organics.

CORROSIVE_ACID.reason: Use separate secondary trays; only oxidizing acids (e.g., HNO3) may share acid cabinets with caution.

CORROSIVE_BASE.reason: Separate oxidizers from bases and organic amines.

HEALTH_HAZARD.reason: Many CMR substances are organic and combustible; keep away from oxidizers.

GENERAL_STORAGE.reason: Store in dedicated tray away from combustible packaging.

FLAMMABLE.reason: Compatible inside an approved flammable storage cabinet.

ACUTE_TOXIC.reason: Only flammable toxics may co-locate; otherwise lock non-flammable poisons separately.

CORROSIVE_ACID.reason: Acids catalyze violent decomposition or ignition of flammable solvents.

CORROSIVE_BASE.reason: Keep separated in secondary containment; volatile amines require flammable cabinet.

HEALTH_HAZARD.reason: Compatible if both are organic solvents; keep away from ignition sources.

GENERAL_STORAGE.reason: Flammables must remain inside fire-rated cabinet away from general shelves.

ACUTE_TOXIC.reason: Compatible in locked poison cabinet using unbreakable secondary trays.

CORROSIVE_ACID.reason: Acids can liberate lethal gases (e.g., HCN, H2S, Cl2) from toxic salts.

CORROSIVE_BASE.reason: Store in separate secondary trays inside locked containment.

HEALTH_HAZARD.reason: Can share secure ventilated storage in separate trays.

GENERAL_STORAGE.reason: Acute toxins require locked access separated from general reagents.

CORROSIVE_ACID.reason: Compatible in acid cabinet (use separate polyethylene trays for mineral vs. organic acids).

CORROSIVE_BASE.reason: Violent exothermic neutralization reaction, heat generation, and spattering.

HEALTH_HAZARD.reason: Corrosive acid fumes degrade containers and react with sensitive organics.

GENERAL_STORAGE.reason: Acid vapors corrode metal caps; keep acids in dedicated corrosion-resistant cabinet.

CORROSIVE_BASE.reason: Compatible in base/alkali cabinet with secondary containment.

HEALTH_HAZARD.reason: Use separate secondary trays to prevent alkaline hydrolysis.

GENERAL_STORAGE.reason: Store strong alkalies in dedicated corrosion-resistant trays.

HEALTH_HAZARD.reason: Compatible on designated, labeled hazardous chemical shelf.

GENERAL_STORAGE.reason: Compatible if containers are sealed and clearly labeled.
Safe for co-storage on standard laboratory shelving.
